title: Parse a price
description: parsePriceToCents(text) turns a typed price into whole cents. It accepts an optional "$" and thousands commas, so "$1,234.50" is 123450. Anything that is not a valid price with at most 2 decimals gives null. sumPrices adds up several prices, or gives null if any of them is invalid.
hint: Try "19.99" and "1,000" by hand. What is 19.99 * 100 in JavaScript?
